concept.concept: A vintage-style illustration of a stack of books with the text 'Fueled by Coffee and Chaos' beneath it.
concept.audience: K-12 teachers preparing for the fall semester
concept.rationale: Back-to-school season hits late August; teachers are a passionate gifting niche with strong identity spending. The humor resonates broadly and avoids IP issues. Competition exists but evergreen demand.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "Fueled by Coffee and Chaos" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a stack of five books in varying heights, tilted slightly off-center, rendered in solid color blocks with clean sharp edges. Books are stacked in a playful, slightly chaotic arrangement. Use a limited palette of 4 colors: deep burgundy, mustard yellow, forest green, and cream. No gradients, no shading, no photorealism. Single centered composition on a plain solid white background with generous margins. The stack should be readable and impactful from across a room at 12x16 inches. Screen-print aesthetic with bold simple shapes and high contrast.
design.style: Bold retro serif typeface, centered directly below the book stack illustration, solid dark color matching one of the palette colors

verdict.reason: The phrase 'Fueled by Coffee and Chaos' is a generic humorous expression combining two common concepts. It does not reference any known registered trademark, brand, celebrity, character, or protected slogan. The vintage book stack illustration is a common generic design element. No IP concerns identified.

image_verdict.reason: The design displays exactly 'Fueled by Coffee and Chaos' with correct spelling across the typography and book spines. The illustration is a clean stack of books with bookmarks, using a retro color palette. No IP concerns, no anatomy issues, no rendering artifacts, and the text is fully legible and correctly spelled.

listing.title: Teacher T-Shirt 'Fueled by Coffee and Chaos' Back to School Tee
listing.description: An honest tribute to the teacher life, featuring a vintage-style stack of books beneath the relatable motto. Perfect for K-12 educators prepping for fall semester or as appreciation from students and families. Celebrates the dual fuel source of every classroom: coffee and the beautiful controlled chaos of education.
